svg.title: Setup in three steps. 1, install the Python dependencies: pip install pyyaml and mcp 2.0 or newer. 2, load the plugin with claude --plugin-dir pointing at the folder or the zip. 3, run /plugin and look for job-search; the Errors tab reports a server that failed to start. Then edit job_search/config/candidate_profile.yaml with your name, links, education, experience, projects, target roles, locations and thresholds, and drop five resume variants in resumes/: resume_apm.pdf for APM and product management, resume_product_analytics.pdf for product analytics, resume_ai_product.pdf for AI product, resume_business_analyst.pdf for business and data analyst roles, resume_general.pdf as the fallback. The database job_applications.db has three tables (jobs, search_log, application_log) and stays local. Requires Python 3.11+, PyYAML and the MCP SDK 2.0+.

div.div:
1Install depspip install pyyaml "mcp>=2.0.0"
On the python3 that Claude launches.

2Load the pluginclaude --plugin-dir ./job-search
Folder or zip. Or unzip into your skills folder to auto load.

3Check it/plugin
Look for job-search. The Errors tab shows a server that failed to start.

Your profile: job_search/config/candidate_profile.yaml holds everything the scorer and answer drafter use.
Your history: job_applications.db, three tables (jobs, search_log, application_log). Stays local, survives plugin updates.
